visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with glasses and a beige baseball cap sits at a wooden table in a brightly lit sushi restaurant. He holds chopsticks and smiles enthusiastically at a plate of salmon roe sushi. (2) A hand enters from the left, extending a bright orange, glossy object with a spherical, bubbly texture toward the man. The man looks up, his expression shifting from anticipation to mild surprise. (3) The man takes the orange object, which is revealed to be a flat cardboard cutout of salmon roe. He turns it over to show the plain white underside, laughing at the flimsy material. (4) He places the cardboard cutout on his head, securing it with an attached white paper band. A promotional graphic for 'Sushi Express' appears briefly as a screen overlay. (5) He adjusts the paper hat while sitting at the table. Cartoon-style headwear overlays appear on other figures in his vision, mimicking the salmon roe and rice headpieces. (6) The man continues to wear the hat while using his chopsticks to eat a piece of salmon roe sushi, smiling and nodding at the camera. (7) A POV shot shows the man holding the paper headpiece up against the background of the restaurant's conveyor belt, highlighting the difference between the 'flat' promotional item and expectations.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy synthesized J-Pop music featuring a female vocal jingle starts immediately. A male voice speaks with bright, upward-inflected pitch, expressing desire for a specific item. Background restaurant chatter provides a low-intensity bed. (2) Music continues at a steady 128 BPM. The male voice emits a sharp, surprised 'Hah?' as paper rustling sounds indicate the receipt of an object. A playful 'Pop' sound effect underscores the reveal. (3) Dialogue ensues between the male and a female companion; the male's tone is humorous and slightly mocking as he realizes the item is made of paper. The upbeat music remains constant in the mix. (4) Further paper rustling occurs as the hat is donned. The male continues speaking with high arousal and positive valence, his speech rate accelerating slightly as he laughs. (5) The phase concludes with the sounds of food consumption (soft crunching) overlapping with the repetitive, catchy brand theme song and final conversational laughter.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to entertain viewers by humorously showcasing a promotional paper hat from 'Sushi Express' (爭鮮). It highlights the gap between the character's expectation of a 3D plush item and the reality of a 2D cardboard cutout, while ultimately promoting the dining experience and the specific 'salmon roe' theme through consumption.
